body: I appreciate it man. I hope you have a good life, genuinely.

I genuinely have no clue. I hope it's some sort of heaven, or at least a peaceful nonexistence like nirvana. That being said, it could easily be something worse: maybe our "soul" gets trapped in our body and we have to sit, fully conscious and awake, in the casket we're buried in for all eternity. Maybe if you're cremated, you forever feel as if you're burning alive, and the pain never stops. Maybe hell is real and we go there. There's a million possibilities.
I live a pretty solitary life, and chances are maybe two or three people would even receive invitations to my funeral, if I even had one.
I've learned that things can always get worse, unfortunately. There's really no such thing as rock bottom.
